description: Look up bookkeeping vouchers by voucher number. GET /vouchers is a LOOKUP endpoint, not a browsable collection: the Lexware API rejects any call without voucherNumber with HTTP 400 "voucherNumber parameter is required". To browse or filter vouchers, use lexware_list_voucherlist, which is the collection endpoint and carries the summary fields (contactName, openAmount) that /vouchers does not.

voucherNumber.description: Voucher number to look up. REQUIRED — the API returns 400 without it.

name: lexware_list_vouchers
title: Look Up Vouchers by Number
